title: Projection 솔로 #036 · glamour hourglass · 프로젝션 만화경 · 팔짱 · 하얀 안뜰 · 글래스 스킨
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 20s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long wavy balayage hair — full body animated light-pattern projected onto her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is pure projected light mapped onto her body and curving to follow its true three-dimensional shape, animated light patterns projected from several unseen projectors onto her skin, the patterns sharp and luminous with crisp edges and slightly warped over every bulge, pools of coloured light spilling onto the floor and faint beams of light visible in the air. Dense projected surface — BLAZING violet, gold and teal kaleidoscope mandala patterns across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID mirrored petals of white light opening and closing across her torso, luminous projected light, completely covering her whole body, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: standing tall, arms crossed under her bust, chin raised, looking down at the camera — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same projection-lit pearl-white gloss, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same projection-lit pearl-white gloss with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-bright glass skin dripping with wet liquid shine, blinding liquid highlighter across the cheekbones, nose bridge, forehead and chin, a flushed dewy blush, mirror-gloss lips.

Background: a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
